title: North-West Fronteir Province Civil Courts Amendment Ordinance 2008

sections.shortTitle: North-West Fronteir Province Civil Courts Amendment Ordinance 2008
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

COURTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2008
ORDINANCE XXII OF
2008
NORTH-WEST FRONTEIR
PROVINCE CIVIL
COURTS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2008
An Ordinance further to
amend the West Pakistan Civil
Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
15th December, 2008]
No.LEGIS;1(7)/79,
dated 15-12-2008.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.:--
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ord. No.II of 1962) for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now therefore in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West
Frontier Province Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further

purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now therefore in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic

Frontier Province is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:
2. Amendment of section 18 of W.P. Ord. No.II of 1962.---In the
West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ord.
No.II of 1962) in section 18, after subsection (1), the following new subsection shall be
inserted, namely:
"(1A) Subject to the provisions of
section 102 of the Code of
Civil Procedure,
1908, no second appeal shall lie in any other suit when the amount or value of
the subject-matter of the original suit does not exceed five hundred thousand
rupees.".
